name: STARHOME
description:
About This Game

STARHOME is a single-player, real-time strategy game where your choices shape the future.

After losing your planet, you set out at the head of the survivor's fleet to find a new home for your people. Venture into the boundless reaches of space, where survival demands a careful balance between resource management and combat. In the harsh and unforgiving depths of the cosmos, you'll need to build a self-sufficient fleet within the constraints of limited space, where every resource counts, and every choice is crucial. Navigate the dangers of deep space, upgrade your fleet, and battle a formidable alien species as you seek to unravel the mystery of your origins. In this never-ending quest, survival is a skill, and the universe is your playground.


The fate of your fleet is in your hands. Every decision you make affects not only your enemies but also the survival of your crew.

No two playthroughs are the same. Each time you play, your fleet will explore a different star cluster and face new challenges. Lead your fleet through the galaxy and shape a unique journey with every decision you make.


Beyond the last known stars, the galaxy holds dangers you cannot predict. Sooner or later, your fleet will cross paths with those who see you as a threat. As captain, will you be ready when the fight begins, or will you have prepared for something else?

When danger strikes, the choice is yours. Retreat and protect your crew, or stand your ground and risk everything. In the unforgiving depths of space, every decision could mean the difference between survival and defeat.


Managing a large crew takes coordination, planning, and a lot of responsibility. Keeping your fleet going means making smart choices about resources and how you use each ship. With limited space and different capabilities on every vessel, you’ll need to carefully balance supplies and equipment.

As you progress, upgrade and adapt your ships to handle increasingly difficult encounters. Bring allied ships into your fleet to expand your options and increase your overall strength.

Build a fleet that can face whatever the galaxy throws at you.


Set out on a journey across the stars. Meet friends and enemies, face hostile forces, and protect your fleet, which has become your new home.

Gather and make use of valuable resources, uncover the secrets of distant worlds, and build a thriving community aboard your ships. The universe offers possibilities far beyond anything you could imagine on Earth. Explore the stars and see what lies beyond.

Climb aboard and begin your journey.
short_desc: Lead the last survivors of your civilization through a hostile galaxy aboard a fleet that has become your new home. Manage every inch of space, balance living quarters, production, defenses, and weapons, and search for refuge before an overwhelming threat finds you.
